html_title: StreetZim — Nā palapala ʻāina pūnaewele ʻole no Kiwix
meta_description: Nā palapala ʻāina OpenStreetMap manuahi e hana ana me ka pūnaewele ʻole ma ka polokalamu heluhelu Kiwix. Nā kile wekekona, nā kiʻi ukali, ka hiʻona ʻāina 3D a me ka ʻike Wikipedia — hana me ka pilina pūnaewele ʻole ma iOS, Android, Mac, Windows a me Linux.
tagline: Nā palapala ʻāina OpenStreetMap e hana ana me ka pūnaewele ʻole ma ka polokalamu heluhelu Kiwix. Nā kile wekekona, nā kiʻi ukali, ka hiʻona ʻāina 3D a me Wikipedia — ʻaʻole pono ka pilina pūnaewele.
badge_mac_title: Kiwix ma ka Mac App Store
maps_intro: E koho i kekahi ʻāpana ma lalo, e hoʻokomo iā Kiwix, a e wehe i ka waihona .zim. Mālama ʻia ma ka Internet Archive — he torrent pū ko kēlā me kēia hoʻoiho.
maps_intro_lang: E koho i kekahi ʻāpana ma lalo a e hoʻoiho iā ia ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi: aia nā inoa o ka palapala ʻāina, ka huli a me Wikipedia ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi. E wehe i ka waihona ma Kiwix, he polokalamu manuahi; hōʻike ka ʻaoʻao o kēlā me kēia palapala ʻāina i ke ʻano e hana ai, i kēlā me kēia ʻanuʻu.
feature_key_intro: Hōʻike nā lepili ma kēlā me kēia kāleka i nā mea o loko:
badge_nav: Ala a me ke kuhikuhi ala

badge_overture: ʻIke hou aku no nā wahi
badge_overture_desc: nā pūnaewele, nā helu kelepona a me nā pāpaho kaiaulu mai Overture,
badge_photo_desc: e loaʻa kekahi wahi mai ke kiʻi o kekahi hōʻailona.

filter_aria: Kānana i ka papa inoa o nā palapala ʻāina
what_lead: Hoʻopūʻolo ʻo StreetZim i ka ʻikepili OpenStreetMap — nā ʻāina a i ʻole nā mokuhonua holoʻokoʻa — i loko o hoʻokahi waihona ZIM e hiki ke wehe ʻia ma Kiwix. Hana ʻo ia me ka pūnaewele ʻole loa: ʻaʻohe kikowaena, ʻaʻohe noi API, ʻaʻole pono ka pūnaewele ma hope o ka hoʻoiho mua ʻana.
what_p2: Hoʻohana nā polokalamu palapala ʻāina pūnaewele ʻole maʻamau i nā kile raster; hoʻohana ʻo StreetZim i nā kile wekekona i kaha ʻia ma kāu hāmeʻa ponoʻī me MapLibre GL JS. ʻO ka hopena: laumania ka neʻe, ka hoʻonui a me ka wili ʻana, a loaʻa pū ka hiʻona ʻāina 3D — mai hoʻokahi waihona ma kāu hāmeʻa.
feat_vector_p: Nā palapala ʻāina laumania a mōakāka a hiki i ke alanui, me ka hoʻolālā OpenMapTiles, i kaha ʻia e MapLibre i ia manawa nō.
feat_sat_p: Nā kiʻi Sentinel-2 ao ʻole, he 10 mika ka miomio, no ka ʻāpana holoʻokoʻa o ka palapala ʻāina.
feat_terrain_p: Ke aka puʻu a me ke kiʻekiʻe 3D mai ka Copernicus GLO-30 DEM o ka honua holoʻokoʻa.
feat_wiki_p: E kaomi i kekahi kūlanakauhale, mauna a wahi kaulana paha e ʻike ai i kāna ʻatikala Wikipedia a me nā ʻike nui.
feat_search_p: E huli ma waena o nā miliona inoa wahi, alanui, pāka, wēkiu, kahua mokulele a me nā POI.
feat_offline_p: Hoʻokahi wale nō waihona .zim. ʻAʻohe moʻokāki, ʻaʻohe hōʻiliʻili ʻikepili, ʻaʻohe pūnaewele. E wehe a hele.
step1_p: He polokalamu heluhelu manuahi no iOS, Android, Mac, Windows a me Linux. Loaʻa ma kiwix.org. Ma Windows a me Linux, e wehe i nā palapala ʻāina ma ka Kiwix PWA i kēia manawa: hōʻike ʻo Kiwix Desktop 2.5 iā lākou me ka hakahaka, a aia kona hoʻoponopono ma nā nightly builds wale nō a hiki i kēia manawa.
step2_p: E koho i kekahi ʻāpana ma luna a e hoʻoiho i ka waihona .zim (a i ʻole e lawe i ka torrent i ʻoi aku ka wikiwiki).
step2_p_lang: E koho i kekahi ʻāpana ma luna a e kaomi i kāna pihi hoʻoiho: loaʻa iā ʻoe ka palapala ʻāina ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi, ma hoʻokahi waihona .zim.
step3_p: E wehe i ka waihona .zim ma ka polokalamu Kiwix. ʻO ia wale nō — hana ka palapala ʻāina me ka pūnaewele ʻole loa.

hero_apps: Wehe ʻia ma ka polokalamu manuahi ʻo Kiwix:
tour_lead: Holo nā mea a pau o kēia mau wikiō mai hoʻokahi waihona ma ka hāmeʻa. Ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia me ka pilina pūnaewele i ʻoki ʻia; ʻo nā lepe ʻōlelo a me nā kiko e hōʻailona ana i kēlā me kēia kaomi wale nō kai hoʻohui ʻia ma hope.
tour_photo_h: E paʻi i ke kiʻi o ka hōʻailona, e loaʻa ka wahi
tour_photo_p: E paʻi i ke kiʻi o kekahi hōʻailona alanui, ke alo o kekahi hale kūʻai a i ʻole ka helu wahi ma ke kāleka kī hōkele, a ʻimi ka palapala ʻāina i ka wahi i kapa ʻia ma laila. Heluhelu ʻia nā huaʻōlelo ma kāu hāmeʻa, ma ke ʻano kākau i kākau ʻia ai: ma ʻaneʻi ka ʻōlelo ʻUkelena, Helene, ʻAlapia, Kepanī, Kōlea, Pākē a me ka Pelekānia, ma ka ʻaoʻao o kekahi i kekahi.
tour_photo_note: Ma nā palapala ʻāina me kēia lepili.
tour_zoom_h: Mai ke kūlanakauhale holoʻokoʻa a i hoʻokahi hale
tour_zoom_p: Mau ka mōakāka o nā palapala ʻāina wekekona ma nā pae hoʻonui a pau: e lele mai Kyiv holoʻokoʻa a i hoʻokahi hale, a laila e hoʻohiō a e wili i ka palapala ʻāina.
tour_drive_h: Kuhikuhi ala i kēlā me kēia huli
tour_drive_p: He ala ma waena o Kyiv, i huli ʻia ma ke kelepona a i hahai ʻia i kēlā me kēia huli. Ua hoʻopaʻa ʻia me kahi wahi hoʻomeamea; holo ka waena o ka huakaʻi he ʻumi manawa ka wikiwiki.
tour_terrain_p: Ke aka puʻu, ka hiʻona ʻāina 3D a me nā kiʻi ukali: nā mauna ma luna aʻe o Tehran.
tour_signs_h: Hoʻokahi ʻano kākau i ka manawa
tour_signs_p: Ka huli like ma kēlā me kēia ʻano kākau, ma ka palapala ʻāina o ke kūlanakauhale kahi e kū nei ka hōʻailona.
tour_credits: Na haʻi nā kiʻi hōʻailona, ke kiʻi o ka puka pā a me nā kiʻi ukali ma kēia mau wikiō a me nā kiʻi papakaumaka: e nānā i nā mea nāna nā kiʻi a me nā laikini.
gallery_lead: Nā papakaumaka maoli mai nā palapala ʻāina, ma ke kamepiula a ma ke kelepona. E koho i kekahi e ʻike ai i kona nui piha, a laila e nānā i nā mea i koe.

langs_h2: Ka palapala ʻāina ma kāu ʻōlelo
langs_lead: Nā inoa wahi, ka huli, ke kuhikuhi ala, nā ʻatikala Wikipedia a me nā papa kuhikuhi o ka palapala ʻāina ponoʻī, ma ka ʻōlelo āu e heluhelu ai. Me nā ʻano kākau mai ka ʻākau a i ka hema pū.
langs_step1_p: E koho iā ia ma ka papa inoa ma lalo, a i ʻole ma ka papa kuhikuhi ma luna o kēlā me kēia ʻaoʻao.
langs_step2_h: E hoʻoiho i ka palapala ʻāina ma ia ʻōlelo
langs_step2_p: Ma ka ʻaoʻao o kāu ʻōlelo, hoʻoiho ka pihi nui o kēlā me kēia palapala ʻāina i ka palapala ʻāina ma ia ʻōlelo, ma hoʻokahi waihona .zim. Hāʻawi kēia ʻaoʻao Pelekānia i kēlā me kēia palapala ʻāina e like me kona kūkulu ʻia ʻana: nā inoa wahi ma ka ʻōlelo o ia wahi, ka ʻaoʻao hoʻohana a me Wikipedia ma ka ʻōlelo Pelekānia.
langs_step2_p_lang: Ma kēia ʻaoʻao, ʻo “Hoʻoiho ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi” ka pihi nui o kēlā me kēia palapala ʻāina: ka palapala ʻāina me kona mau inoa wahi, ka huli, Wikipedia a me nā papa kuhikuhi ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi, ma hoʻokahi waihona .zim. Inā ʻaʻole i mākaukau kekahi palapala ʻāina ma ka ʻōlelo Hawaiʻi, hōʻike kāna kāleka pēlā.
langs_step3_p: Hiki ke hana ʻia nā palapala ʻāina he nui ma nā ʻōlelo e ʻōlelo ʻia ana ma laila, e like me ka ʻōlelo Katalana no Kepania a me Pokukala a i ʻole ka ʻōlelo Welaka no Pelekāne a me ʻIlelani. Helu ʻo Nā palapala ʻāina ma nā ʻōlelo ʻē aʻe i nā ʻōlelo a pau o nā palapala ʻāina a pau a hoʻohui i ka waihona ma kāu polokalamu kele.
langs_demo_note: Ka palapala ʻāina like o Kyiv ma ka ʻōlelo ʻAlapia, Hebera, Hīnī, Tai, Kepanī a me ka Pākē. Inā ʻaʻohe unuhina o kekahi inoa, waiho ʻia e like me ke kākau ʻana ma ia wahi.
langs_grid_note: ʻO ka helu ka nui o nā palapala ʻāina i mākaukau ma ia ʻōlelo i kēia lā.
filter_none: ʻAʻohe palapala ʻāina i kūlike me kēlā. E hoʻāʻo i kekahi ʻāina, ʻāpana a kūlanakauhale paha.
credits_h: Nā kiʻi ma nā wikiō a me nā kiʻi papakaumaka
